items.title: 8.1.2 Real Life Application of Mathematical Induction (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Assalam o alaikum! Ab tak hum ne induction se formulas aur inequalities saabit keen. Is hisse mein dekhenge ke yahi tareeqa rozmarra zindagi ke masail mein kaise kaam aata hai. Kitab kehti hai ke mathematical induction ek taqatwar tareeqa hai jis se natural numbers ke liye banayi gayi statements saabit ki jati hain. Maths mein yeh aksar sequences (tarteeb se aane wale numbers), series (un ka sum) aur aisi doosri cheezon ke baare mein nataij ko durust saabit karne ke liye istemal hota hai jin mein integer values hon.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Zindagi mein bohat si cheezein har qadam par ek muqarrar miqdaar se badalti hain: har mahine bank mein jama hone wali raqam, har din barhne wale push-ups, har hafte kam hone wali calories. \(n\) qadam ke baad jo value hoti hai woh \(n\) ka ek formula ban jati hai.
Induction is formula ko har \(n\) ke liye pakka karta hai: pehle qadam ke baad formula sahi hai (base case), aur agar \(k\) qadam ke baad sahi hai to ek aur qadam ke baad bhi sahi rahega (step). Bas, yahi saari kahani hai. Har sawal mein khud se poochiye: "pehle qadam ke baad kya hai?" aur "ek qadam aage barhne se kya badalta hai?"

blocks.title: Example 9
blocks.problem: Mr. Faris starts a savings plan where he deposits Rs. 1,000 rupees into his bank account every month. Using mathematical induction, prove that the total amount saved after \(n\) months is given by: \(S(n) = 1000 \times n\) rupees, where \(n\) is a positive integer representing the number of months.
steps:
Given: har mahine Rs. 1000 jama hote hain. Statement \(S(n)\): \(n\) mahine baad kul bachat \(1000 \times n\) rupees hai.
To prove: har positive integer \(n\) ke liye \(S(n)\) sach hai.
Method: sab se pehle dekhte hain ke yahan \(n\) mahinon ki tadaad hai, is liye induction mahinon par lagayenge.

Step 1: Base case (n = 1)
Pehle mahine ke baad Faris Rs. 1000 bachata hai. Is liye ek mahine baad kul bachat:
\[1000 \times 1 = 1000 \text{ rupees}\]
Base case \(S(1)\) sach hai.
Kyun: ek mahine mein sirf ek dafa raqam jama hui.

Step 2: Induction hypothesis
Farz karein ke kisi positive integer \(k\) ke liye statement sach hai, yani \(k\) mahine baad kul bachat:
\[S(k) = 1000 \times k \text{ rupees}\]

Step 3: k + 1 mahinon ke liye saabit karein
\(k + 1\) mahine baad Rs. 1000 ki ek aur qist jama hoti hai, to kul bachat:
\[S(k + 1) = 1000 \times k + 1000\]
\[= 1000 \times (k + 1) \text{ rupees}\]
Yani agar statement \(k\) ke liye sach hai to \(k + 1\) ke liye bhi sach hai.
Kyun: mahina number \(k + 1\) pichli kul raqam mein sirf ek qist (1000) jama karta hai. 1000 ko common nikaalne se wahi formula \(n = k + 1\) ke saath mil jata hai.

Step 4: Justification and Communication
Mathematical induction se hum ne saabit kiya ke har mahine Rs. 1000 bachane se \(n\) mahinon mein kul \(1000 \times n\) rupees bante hain. Base case (\(n = 1\)) sach hai, aur \(k\) mahinon ke liye sach maan kar hum ne \(k + 1\) ke liye dikhaya. Is liye statement tamam natural numbers \(n\) ke liye durust hai, aur real-life mein is par bharosa kiya ja sakta hai.
Kyun: zindagi ke masail mein nateeja lafzon mein bhi bataya jata hai (communication, yani baat doosron tak pohanchana), taa ke jo maths nahin jaanta woh bhi samajh sake ke kya saabit hua.

Tasdeeq:
12 mahine baad: \(1000 \times 12 = 12000\) rupees, yani Rs. 1000 ki 12 qistein. Sahi.
blocks.answer: Saabit ho gaya: \(n\) mahine baad kul bachat \(S(n) = 1000 \times n\) rupees hai, har positive integer \(n\) ke liye.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Example 9 mein pronouns (zameer) gadmad hain: "Mr. Faris ... where she deposits ... into his bank account". Mr. Faris mard hain, is liye "he deposits ... into his bank account" hona chahiye. Hal mein bhi "you would save" likha hai, jis se muraad Faris hi hai. Hisaab par koi asar nahin.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
1. Agar Faris har mahine Rs. 1000 ke bajaye Rs. 2500 jama kare to \(n\) mahine baad formula kya hoga, aur induction ka step kaise likhenge? (Jawab: \(S(n) = 2500n\); step: \(2500k + 2500 = 2500(k + 1)\).)
2. Faris ko Rs. 30,000 jama karne mein kitne mahine lagenge? (Jawab: \(1000n = 30000\), yani \(n = 30\) mahine.)

blocks.title: Dhyan dein
blocks.text:
Yeh misaal itni aasan lagti hai ke shayad aap sochein induction ki kya zaroorat thi: "har mahine 1000, to \(n\) mahine mein \(1000n\), baat khatam." Asal mein aap ka yeh zehni hisaab bhi induction hi hai! Aap ne socha: ek mahine mein 1000, aur har naya mahina 1000 aur jorta hai, to har mahine ke baad formula sahi rehta hai. Kitab bas isi soch ko pakki zabaan mein likhna sikha rahi hai.
Is aasan misaal ka faida yeh hai ke induction ke teeno hisse (base case, hypothesis aur step, conclusion) bilkul saaf nazar aate hain, aur hisaab ka bojh nahin hota. Agli misaalon mein yahi dhaancha thore mushkil hisaab ke saath aayega. Exam mein real-life sawal mein bhi yahi teen headings likhiye, aur aakhir mein nateeja lafzon mein bataiye.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan "Example 8" aur "Example 9" dobara chhapti hai (oopar wale Example 9 ke baad), yani yeh dono number unit mein do do dafa aate hain. Tarteeb se yeh 10th aur 11th misaalein hoteen; hum ne chhape hue number rakhe hain aur saath "[printed again]" likha hai, taa ke pehchan mein ghalti na ho.
Ab ek aisi misaal jahan har din ki miqdaar barhti hai, aur humein kul jama (total) ka formula saabit karna hai. Yeh pichli misaal se thori mushkil hai, kyun ke yahan har din ka hissa barabar nahin.

blocks.title: Example 8 [printed again]
blocks.problem: Imagine Ali starts a daily exercise routine where each day he increases the number of push-ups he does by 2. On the first day, he does 10 push-ups. Prove that on the \(n^{\text{th}}\) day, the total number of push-ups Ali has done is \(n^{2} + 9n\).
steps:
Given: pehle din 10 push-ups; har din pichle din se 2 zyada. Yani din number \(d\) par Ali \(10 + 2(d - 1)\) push-ups karta hai: 10, 12, 14, 16, ...
To prove: \(S(n)\): \(n\) din mein kul push-ups \(n^{2} + 9n\) hain, har positive integer \(n\) ke liye.
Method: dinon ki tadaad par induction. Dhyan dein: formula kul jama ka hai, sirf aakhri din ka nahin.

Step 1: Base case (n = 1)
Pehle din Ali 10 push-ups karta hai, to kul:
\[\text{Total} = 10 = 1^{2} + 9(1)\]
Base case \(S(1)\) sach hai.
Kyun: formula mein \(n = 1\) rakhne se \(1 + 9 = 10\) aata hai, jo pehle din ke push-ups hain.

Step 2: Induction hypothesis
Farz karein ke kisi positive integer \(k\) ke liye statement sach hai, yani \(k\) din mein kul push-ups:
\[S(k) = k^{2} + 9k\]

Step 3: Din k + 1 ke push-ups
\((k + 1)\)th din Ali \(10 + 2 \times k\) push-ups karta hai.
Kyun: pehle din 10 the, aur us ke baad \(k\) dinon mein har din 2 barhe: \(10 + 2[(k + 1) - 1] = 10 + 2k\). Aksar bachay yahan \(10 + 2(k + 1)\) likh dete hain, jo ek din aage ka hisaab hai.

Step 4: k + 1 din ka kul
\[k^{2} + 9k + (10 + 2k)\]
\[= k^{2} + 2k + 1 + 9k + 9\]
\[= (k + 1)^{2} + 9(k + 1)\]
Formula \(S(k + 1)\) ke liye bhi sach hai.
Kyun: jama karne se \(k^{2} + 11k + 10\) bana. Humein yeh \(n^{2} + 9n\) ki shakal mein \(n = k + 1\) ke saath chahiye, is liye ise \((k^{2} + 2k + 1) + (9k + 9)\) mein toda: pehla hissa \((k + 1)^{2}\) aur doosra \(9(k + 1)\) hai.

Step 5: Conclusion
Mathematical induction se \(n\) din mein kul push-ups \(n^{2} + 9n\) hain.
blocks.answer: Saabit ho gaya: \(n\) din mein Ali ke kul push-ups \(n^{2} + 9n\) hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Example 8 [printed again] ke base case mein kitab "Total push-ups \(= 10 \times 1 - 10\)" chhapti hai. Sahi: Total push-ups \(= 10 = 1^{2} + 9(1)\).

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Push-ups 10, 12, 14, ... ek arithmetic progression (A.P.) hain, jis mein \(a = 10\) aur \(d = 2\). A.P. ke sum ka formula \(S_{n} = \frac{n}{2}[2a + (n - 1)d]\) lagaein to \(\frac{n}{2}(20 + 2n - 2) = n(n + 9) = n^{2} + 9n\) aata hai, bilkul wahi jawab.
Kyun dono tareeqe: A.P. ka formula seedha jawab deta hai, jab ke induction yeh saabit karta hai ke jawab har \(n\) ke liye sahi hai. Exam mein agar "using mathematical induction" likha ho to induction hi likhiye.
Ab aakhri misaal, jis mein miqdaar har hafte kam ho rahi hai. Yahan formula kisi ek hafte ki daily intake (rozana khurak) ka hai, kul jama ka nahin. Yeh farq pehchanna zaroori hai.

blocks.title: Example 9 [printed again]
blocks.problem: Suppose you aim to lose weight by reducing your calorie intake by 50 calories each week. If you start at 2500 calories, prove that after \(n\) weeks, your daily intake is \(2500 - 50n\) calories.
steps:
Given: shuru mein rozana 2500 calories; har hafte 50 calories kam.
To prove: \(S(n)\): \(n\) hafton baad rozana intake \(2500 - 50n\) calories hai, har positive integer \(n\) ke liye.
Method: hafton ki tadaad par induction.

Step 1: Base case (n = 1)
Ek hafte baad intake:
\[2500 - 50 = 2450 \text{ calories}\]
aur formula bhi \(2500 - 50(1) = 2450\) deta hai. Base case \(S(1)\) sach hai.

Step 2: Induction hypothesis
Farz karein ke kisi positive integer \(k\) ke liye statement sach hai, yani \(k\) hafton baad intake:
\[S(k): 2500 - 50k \text{ calories}\]

Step 3: k + 1 hafton ke liye saabit karein
\(k + 1\) hafton baad intake:
\[2500 - 50k - 50\]
\[= 2500 - 50(k + 1) \text{ calories}\]
Formula \(k + 1\) ke liye bhi sach hai.
Kyun: ek hafta aur guzarne se intake \(k\) hafton wali intake se 50 calories kam ho jati hai. \(-50\) ko common nikaalne se \(-50k - 50 = -50(k + 1)\) bana, yani formula \(n = k + 1\) ke saath.

Step 4: Conclusion
Mathematical induction se \(n\) hafton baad rozana intake \(2500 - 50n\) calories hai.

Tasdeeq:
4 hafton baad: \(2500 - 200 = 2300\) calories; hafta ba hafta \(2450 \to 2400 \to 2350 \to 2300\). Sahi.
blocks.answer: Saabit ho gaya: \(n\) hafton baad rozana intake \(2500 - 50n\) calories hai.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
1. Kitne hafton baad intake 2000 calories ho jayegi? (Jawab: \(2500 - 50n = 2000\), yani \(n = 10\) hafte.)
2. Ali 5th din kitne push-ups karta hai, aur 5 din mein kul kitne? (Jawab: 5th din \(10 + 2(4) = 18\); kul \(5^{2} + 9(5) = 70\).)
3. Kya calorie wala formula har \(n\) ke liye zindagi mein bhi maana ja sakta hai? (Jawab: maths mein formula har \(n\) ke liye sach hai, lekin \(n = 50\) par intake 0 aur us ke baad negative ho jati hai, jo mumkin nahin. Real-life model hamesha ek had tak hi kaam karta hai.)

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh hamari practice hai, kitab ka sawal nahin. Sana pehle mahine Rs. 200 bachati hai, aur har mahine pichle mahine se Rs. 100 zyada. Saabit kijiye ke \(n\) mahinon mein kul bachat \(50n^{2} + 150n\) rupees hai.
Mahina \(m\) ki bachat: \(200 + 100(m - 1)\). Mahina \(k + 1\) ki bachat: \(200 + 100k\).
Base case (\(n = 1\)): \(50 + 150 = 200\). Sach.
Hypothesis: \(k\) mahinon mein kul \(50k^{2} + 150k\).
Step: \(50k^{2} + 150k + 200 + 100k = 50k^{2} + 250k + 200\). Aur \(50(k + 1)^{2} + 150(k + 1) = 50k^{2} + 100k + 50 + 150k + 150 = 50k^{2} + 250k + 200\). Dono barabar, is liye formula \(k + 1\) ke liye bhi sach.
Dekhiye, yeh bilkul push-ups wala dhaancha hai: pehle agle mahine ka hissa nikaalo, phir kul mein jama karo, phir formula ki shakal se milao.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Zindagi ka koi bhi qaida jo har qadam par muqarrar miqdaar jorhta (ya ghatata) hai, \(n\) ka formula deta hai; induction use har \(n\) ke liye saabit karta hai.
2. Base case: pehle qadam ke baad ki soorat. Hypothesis: \(k\) qadam ke baad ka formula. Step: qadam \(k + 1\) mein jo hota hai woh jama karein aur nateeje ko \(n = k + 1\) wale formula ki shakal mein likhein.
3. Real-life sawal mein nateeja lafzon mein bhi likhiye (Justification and Communication).
4. Pehle pehchaniye ke formula ek qadam ki miqdaar ka hai (calories) ya kul jama ka (push-ups, bachat).

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Din \(k + 1\) ke push-ups \(10 + 2(k + 1)\) likh dena. Sahi \(10 + 2k\) hai, kyun ke pehle din 10 the aur din \(k + 1\) tak sirf \(k\) dafa 2 barhe hain. Bachne ka tareeqa: \(k = 0\) rakh kar dekhiye; pehle din ke 10 aane chahiyein.
2. Ek din ki miqdaar aur kul jama ko mila dena. Push-ups wali misaal kul ki hai; calories wali misaal ek hafte ki intake ki hai.
3. \(k^{2} + 11k + 10\) par ruk jana aur yeh na dikhana ke yeh \((k + 1)^{2} + 9(k + 1)\) ke barabar hai. Manzil ki shakal tak pohanchna zaroori hai.
